description: Shape of music-manifest.json at the repo root, written by build_music_manifest() in code/build_site_files.py. It is the single source of truth for every visible count on the site (songs, library, equipment, beats, index hashes, timestamps). Regenerated by the drip/build after every run. NOTE: no 'license' field exists anywhere in the manifest or in the record-page JSON-LD (API.md); do not add one.

id_ranges.description: Computed from the index rows: first/last/count per kind. Keys are the index kind column values ('song','sound','gear','beat').

deep_links.description: Canonical per-record URL patterns (relative to the site base).

determinism.description: 'same request + same engine version + same voice version = same composition (structure, chords, melody, lyrics) and same rendered WAV bytes'. See DETERMINISM.md for the precise guarantee (record spec is fully deterministic; the render noise layer is not byte-exact).

seed_algorithm.description: Documented as 'FNV-1a 32-bit (hashSeed)'. ACTUAL implementation in assets/synth.js is xmur3 (MurmurHash3-derived) feeding mulberry32. See DETERMINISM.md.

version.description: Current engine version. Records' specs are stable across engine upgrades.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the build.

id_schemes.description: All ten ID schemes. Four are live with issued records; five are reserved with no records issued yet.

chunk_pointers_verified.description: True when every index row's chunk pointer was verified to resolve to the record.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the index.json.gz file bytes.

composition_stable.description: The song spec (notes/chords/lyrics/structure) is stable even if the render engine improves.

voices_note.description: 'All voices are synthesized. There are no human singers on this site — no exceptions.'

title: Signature Music Studio — music-manifest.json
